decisions.quote: Our main study was conducted on a nationally representative sample of 737 White adults.11 In addition to the main study, we also conducted a pretest and a replication to examine alternative explanations for the results.
decisions.reason: The article develops and tests an original theoretical account of the interaction between candidate race, campaign negativity, and racial attitudes; its reported 'replication study' repeats its own main experiment within the same paper rather than re-testing a previously published finding.

decisions.quote: Consistent with past research (Kahn & Geer, 1994), we find that sponsoring a negative advertisement leads to a penalty (Figure 2a).
decisions.reason: Because the paper is an original study (not_a_replication), no original target study applies; Kahn and Geer (1994) is cited only as background literature for the general backlash penalty of negative advertising.

decisions.quote: While we find, consistent with previous research, that respondents unfavorably evaluate candidates who decide to sponsor a negative ad, there are two important exceptions to this pattern
decisions.reason: Because the study is not a replication of a prior published finding, a replication outcome is inapplicable; the quoted passage summarizes the authors' own novel experimental findings rather than a replication verdict on Kahn and Geer (1994).
